question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH r_words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
),
r_words_with_key AS (
  SELECT words,
         STRING_AGG(SUBSTR(words, i + 1, 1), '' ORDER BY SUBSTR(words, i + 1, 1)) AS sorted_key
  FROM r_words,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, LENGTH(words) - 1)) AS t(i)
  GROUP BY words
),
anagram_groups AS (
  SELECT sorted_key,
         COUNT(*) AS anagram_count
  FROM r_words_with_key
  GROUP BY sorted_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT aw.words,
       ag.anagram_count
FROM r_words_with_key aw
JOIN anagram_groups ag ON aw.sorted_key = ag.sorted_key
ORDER BY aw.words
LIMIT 10
